'''May 2001 Milner tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Milner, GA on 12 May 2001. It is known from Adam Beauchamp's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d2318">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-05-16-golf-shirts-in-milner-ga-5-12-01d2318/ golf-shirts-in-milner-ga-5-12-01], DeckTech (Adam "Vincent Vega" Beauchamp, 16 May 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-05-16-golf-shirts-in-milner-ga-5-12-01d2318/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 12 May 2001
* '''Site:''' Milner, GA
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Reflections II]]
* '''Players:''' 8
